scope: Only valid when Spectre completes successfully
description: PSF data files only exist after a successful simulation run. A non-nil run() return is NOT sufficient proof of success - must verify PSF files exist and spectre.out shows no fatal errors.
evidence: src/spectre/runner.rs:has_usable_output() checks data.is_empty() before accepting results

description: gm/Id methodology is only valid when transistor is in saturation (region ≈ 2 in Spectre). Triode or cutoff transistors have different gm/Id relationships.
evidence: PSF STRUCT/OP block contains region field: 0=off, 1=triode, 2=saturation, 3=subthreshold

description: SKILL functions return nil to indicate failure, not an error message. The VirtuosoResult.status may be Success (STX received) while output is 'nil'. Always check skill_ok() not just ok().
Sessions can become stale if Virtuoso crashes or loses connection. ipcIsAliveProcess check determines if session is still alive. Stale sessions may still have cached port info.
The ADE session binds run() to the resultsDir established when the GUI session was created. Changing resultsDir breaks run() - it returns nil. Do not call sim setup after working ADE session exists.

Spectre may report errors in spectre.out without the simulation aborting. Always check tail of spectre.out, not just exit code. Spectre can terminate with fatal errors and run() still returns resultsDir.
Spectre vsource uses mag= for AC amplitude, NOT ac= (which is SPICE-compat only and causes SFE-30). Default mag=0 produces zero AC response. Must set mag=1 explicitly for AC analysis.
Noise oprobe must be a parallel probe (resistor to ground), NOT a series probe. Series probes measure voltage across resistor (≈0 at low freq) causing wildly inflated input-referred noise.
Remote sessions require active SSH tunnel. Tunnel must be started with vcli tunnel start before connecting to remote Virtuoso. Daemon must be deployed/attached on remote host.
Transistor operating points are named by instance, not device. M0, M1, etc. are schematic instance names. Parsing must handle both <instance>:<param> format.
